source_updates.title: MIDIBack: Harmony-Aware Singing Pitch Correction via Joint Vocal-Accompaniment Symbolic Modeling
revisions: targets are rounded GAME transcription pitches rather than independent scores
all baseline numbers are reproductions inside the same pseudo-target pipeline, not original published evaluations
the 80/10/10 split does not document singer-, artist-, song-family-, or source-dataset-disjoint grouping
the counterfactual backing-transposition case study demonstrates sensitivity, not correctness or human-like harmonic reasoning
no public MIDIBack code, checkpoint, exact GAME/MuScriptor configuration, split manifest, or waveform correction path was verified
source_updates.limited_conclusion: MIDIBack is evidence that accompaniment tokens can help recover synthetic symbolic pitch shifts under a pseudo-target protocol; it is not independent evidence of perceptually correct or deployable vocal correction.

source_updates.title: BERT-APC: BERT-based Automatic Pitch Correction for Amateur Singing Voice
revisions: BERT-APC evaluates against score-derived ground truth and includes TD-PSOLA audio plus a listening test
MIDIBack reuses the learnable detuner scheme but substitutes rounded automatic transcriptions for score targets
MIDIBack's reproduced BERT-APC baseline is therefore not the original BERT-APC evaluation and cannot serve as independent confirmation

source_updates.title: A Multi-Resolution Spectrogram Approach for Estimating the Physical Parameters of a Plate Reverb
revisions: the 200-IR local table appears to be model-selection-adjacent but independence and seeds are not documented
the abstract's 5000-IR mean and the 200-IR table differ substantially without a reconciled protocol
no public submission code, checkpoint, configuration, or split manifest was found

source_updates.title: The 1st DAFx Challenge: Physical and Modal Parameter Estimation for Plate Reverberation
revisions: participant timings were reported by participants rather than rerun on common hardware
organizers received code, but the inspected public repository exposes technical reports and organizer tools rather than the plate-paper participant implementation
for a real plate, the synthetic parameterization may lack a uniquely valid ground truth, so transfer is not merely ordinary distribution shift

findings: GAME emits floating-point pitch and configurable note-boundary/note-presence decisions
MIDIBack does not identify the GAME checkpoint, revision, thresholds, slicer configuration, or adaptation from GAME's documented 44.1-kHz path to its 22.05-kHz mono pipeline
no oracle/manual-transcription ablation isolates GAME error propagation
public code and small/medium/large checkpoints exist, but local use requires authenticated acceptance of the non-commercial weights license
MIDIBack does not state which MuScriptor model variant, checkpoint revision, decoding options, quantization, or instrument-presence settings produced accompaniment tokens
the audited repository revision postdates the MIDIBack submission and is not evidence of the authors' exact environment
the public tree contains organizer Task A/Task B tools and participant technical-report PDFs
no directory, checkpoint, or runnable configuration for the plate-paper entry was found
the official statement that code was supplied to organizers does not establish public reproducibility

knowledge_cards.claim: Recovery against a rounded transcription target can measure consistency with the transcription stack rather than correctness against musical intent.
MIDIBack's BERT-APC comparison is a reimplementation under pseudo-target conditions, not an independent reproduction of BERT-APC's score-grounded audio evaluation.
The learned detuner links MIDIBack and BERT-APC into a dependent method family rather than two independent confirmations.
Accompaniment improves synthetic global-shift recovery but worsens reported clean-note preservation, requiring an explicit reject gate.
Following an artificially transposed accompaniment proves counterfactual sensitivity, not that the proposed note is musically correct.
GAME and MuScriptor versions, checkpoints and decoding settings are latent experimental factors absent from MIDIBack's reproducibility record.
A 1024-token maximum without a documented truncation/segmentation policy leaves long-form coverage and boundary behavior uncertain.
The combined MIDIBack corpus lacks a public per-source split and rights manifest, so it cannot be assumed reproducible or reusable.
MuScriptor code is MIT but its checkpoints are CC BY-NC 4.0; code availability does not confer unrestricted weight use.
The public DAFx challenge repository does not currently expose the plate-paper participant code or checkpoint even though code was supplied to organizers.
The 5000-, 200-, and 16-IR plate results remain unreconciled protocols and cannot be pooled into one accuracy claim.
Real-plate validation may lack a unique ground-truth mapping to the challenge's synthetic physical parameters; signal and perceptual endpoints are therefore required.

experiments.title: Automatic versus independent symbolic input for accompaniment-aware target prediction
experiments.baseline: manual/oracle vocal and accompaniment note events feeding one fixed target predictor and one fixed bounded correction engine
experiments.variant: GAME plus MuScriptor events feeding the same predictor and engine
experiments.material: rights-cleared multitracks with independent note and acceptable-target annotations
experiments.loudness_matching: retain raw safety renders; make separate integrated-loudness-matched blind copies
experiments.success: automatic input preserves the oracle-input advantage without materially higher clean-note corruption or audible damage
experiments.cancel: dependency versions are unpinned, targets are not independent, or protected qualities worsen

experiments.title: Rounded pseudo-target versus independent expert target
experiments.baseline: score and select one fixed predictor against independent expert targets
experiments.variant: score the identical outputs against rounded GAME transcription targets
experiments.loudness_matching: not applicable until the fixed audio engine stage
experiments.success: ranking remains stable under independent targets
experiments.cancel: expert target depends on GAME or model output

experiments.title: Counterfactual accompaniment sensitivity versus musical validity
experiments.variant: one preregistered musically valid reharmonization or transposition
experiments.loudness_matching: not applicable for symbolic stage; fixed-engine renders must be loudness matched separately
experiments.success: movement tracks independently valid alternatives rather than arbitrary token shifts
experiments.cancel: the manipulation lacks an independently acceptable target

experiments.title: Plate phase-channel transfer with matched and deliberately mismatched holdouts
experiments.variant: same model with the paper's phase channel
controls: same capacity apart from input channel
experiments.loudness_matching: separate loudness-matched listening copies only for full-band rendered comparisons
experiments.success: phase benefit survives preregistered OOD/measured signal endpoints
experiments.cancel: public code/checkpoint is unavailable, labels are ill-defined, or gains remain matched-simulator-only

priorities: independent-target and transcription-source null tests for MIDIBack
MIDIBack code, checkpoint, exact dependency settings and group-disjoint split manifest
public release or author clarification for the plate participant implementation and 5000/200/16-IR protocols
existing SpanSynth, DiffusionRIR, BSRNN and SRF-SVB controlled tests
permitted transcript retrieval for 38 queued videos
per-file rights-cleared rock multitracks with raw tracks, stems and final mix

notes: BERT-APC is retained as a dependent method-family comparator, not independent confirmation of MIDIBack
the plate paper, its technical report and the official challenge report are linked benchmark evidence, not three replications

handoff: Treat MIDIBack as a transcription-dependent symbolic hypothesis generator. Pin GAME and MuScriptor, validate against independent targets, and reject clean-note damage before any fixed-engine audio A/B. The plate entry remains non-reproducible from public artifacts; keep simulator accuracy separate from measured signal and listening endpoints.
